item.title: Re-reading the ARTEX Attacks on Korea's Financial Sector: AI Agents, Disposable VPS Infrastructure, and Non-Customer-Facing Systems
item.description: A detailed analysis of the ARTEX-linked attacks on Korea's financial sector using public reporting, Shodan/Censys exposure data, anonymous-vps cross-checks, and observed IoCs. The focus is not just the AI tool itself, but disposable infrastructure, non-customer-facing business systems, LLM credential theft, and the defensive changes likely to follow.
